create_dataset_registry: create a DatasetRegistry from a TOML config path to manage multiple dataset namespaces
list_namespaces: list all registered dataset namespaces from the community registry
list_builders: list all available dataset builder names across all registered namespaces
get_builder_cls: get the DatasetBuilder class for a specific dataset by namespace and name
get_builder: instantiate a DatasetBuilder instance for a given dataset name with optional kwargs
